head: ead4ce42
subject: RDS literal prefix and authority rewrites
change: RDS RouteAction now decodes prefix_rewrite, host_rewrite_literal and host_rewrite_header. The selector records the rewrite once per RPC and the shared request-input copy applies it to the owned path/authority before unary or streaming admission. A prefix match replaces only the matched route prefix; other path matches replace the complete path. A header authority rewrite uses the first visible value, including pseudo-headers. Rewritten values are bounded by the selector max_header_bytes. Regex, format-substitution, policy and automatic-host rewrites fail validation instead of being silently ignored; deprecated top-level timeout offsets and routing priority also fail closed.

tests.unit: src/grpc/xds/rds/tests.zig 'gRPC RDS rewrites matched prefixes and literal or header authorities' and 'gRPC RDS rejects unsupported regex and format rewrites'
tests.wire: src/grpc/xds/rds/transport_tests.zig 'gRPC RDS rewrites path and authority on the wire' starts a real gRPC server, routes a unary RPC through SharedChannel, and asserts the server observed /api.Service/Get and rewritten.example

test_lib.note: Focused RDS selector, decoder, lifecycle and transport gate. A full test-lib run on the same worktree reached 6433/6434 with only the known host-load-sensitive WebSocket rejection timing failure; a later full run under heavier host load added unrelated WebSocket/SOCKS5/LRS timing failures.

notes: The rewrite descriptor is internal request state. It is cleared by the owned-input copy, so retries and hedged attempts apply the rewrite exactly once to the original application path.
